Apply the requested procurement collaboration access adjustment to the matching target identified from the prior workspace scan.

Derive the access-manager target identifier or identifiers for the discovered private procurement terms folder target role, preserving only identifiers from the task-authorized scanner results.
Create the task-requested shareable access for the discovered private procurement terms folder target using the registered procurement access manager.
